tr

ime

lit the Markdown content by lines
    lines =
 markdown.strip().split('\n')

expression to match table separators

rator_re = re.compile(r'\|[^|]*\|')

ocess each line and remove extra spaces in th
e table
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):

        if separator_re.match(line):
        
    # Split the table cells by the '|' charac
ter

       # Remove leading and trailing spaces f
rom each cell
            cleaned_cells = [ce
ll.strip() for cell in cells]
            # R
econstruct the line with cleaned cells
      
      lines[i] = '|'.join(cleaned_cells)

   updated_markdown_content = '\n'.join(lines
)

rator_re = re.compile(r'\|[^|]*\|')

ocess each line and remove extra spaces in th

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):

    # Split the table cells by the '|' charac

            # R
econstruct the line with cleaned cells
      
      lines[i] = '|'.join(cleaned_cells)

"""
    Visitor
    -------
    The Visitor d
esign pattern allows adding new operations to
 a group of
    related objects without modif
ying their individual classes. It separates
 
   the behavior from the objects by introduci
ng a visitor object that visits
    and perfo
rms operations on the objects. This promotes 
extensibility and
    follows the Open-Closed
 Principle by allowing new behaviors to be ad
ded
    without modifying existing code.

   
 - All descriptions and comments created by C
hatGPT and GitHub Copilot
"""
from abc import
 ABC, abstractmethod

class Furniture(ABC):
 
   """
        Abstract class for furniture
 
   """
    @abstractmethod
    def accept(sel
f, visitor: "Visitor") -> None:
        pass


class Chair(Furniture):
    """
        Chai
r class
    """
    def accept(self, visitor:
 "Visitor") -> None:
        visitor.visit_ch
air(self)

    def sit(self) -> None:
       
 print("Sitting on the chair")

class Table(F
urniture):
    """
        Table class
    ""
"
    def accept(self, visitor: "Visitor") ->
 None:
        visitor.visit_table(self)

   
 def place_items(self) -> None:
        print
("Placing items on the table")

class Visitor
(ABC):
    """
        Abstract class for vis
itors
    """
    @abstractmethod
    def vis
it_chair(self, chair: Chair) -> None:
       
 """
            Visit a chair
        """
  
      pass

    @abstractmethod
    def visit
_table(self, table: Table) -> None:
        "
""
            Visit a table
        """
    
    pass

class FurnitureCleaner(Visitor):
  
  """
        Concrete Visitor
    """
    de
f visit_chair(self, chair: Chair) -> None:
  
      chair.sit()

    def visit_table(self, 
table: Table) -> None:
        table.place_it
ems()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Clie
nt Code
    furniture_items = [Chair(), Table
()]
    cleaner = FurnitureCleaner()

    # V
isit all furniture items
    for item in furn
iture_items:
        item.accept(cleaner)

Release v0.1.0

Merge `dev` to `main`
Merge pull request #8 from moshemoshe137/dev

Merge pull request #23 from moshemoshe137/remove-typing.Union

Remove `typing.Union`

Merge pull request #22 from moshemoshe137/update-GH-actions

Updates GitHub actions - Fixes #19

Merge pull request #21 from moshemoshe137/acknowledge_copyright

Add EAB Acknowledgements and Disclaimer

Merge pull request #16 from moshemoshe137/add_py312_gh_actions

Add Python 3.12 to GitHub Actions
Fix an issue where not enough records were created
Add flags for skipping certain generators
Fix issues with extreme values of `n-records`
Fix an error that could occur w/ some RANDOM_SEEDs

Restructure file

Most code is now inside a function, `generate_fake_enrollments`.
Additionally, all argument parsing has moved to an
`if __name__ == "__main__"` block.

Add `generate-all-test-data.py`

There are a few different files used to generate test data. This
centralizes everything in a single Python script.
Convert Jupyter Notebook to Python script

Fix Python 3.9 typing error

```
EAB_tools\io\enrollment.py:36: error: X | Y syntax for unions requires Python
3.10  [syntax]
        header: int | Sequence[int] | None | Literal["infer"] = 1,
                ^
```
So we added `from __future__ import annotations`.
`pyupgrade` also removed the `Optional` type hint.

"Modernize" `load_enrollments_report`

- Handle time formats with bad timezones.
- Add a kwarg for the `header`.
Add (improper) timezone to Start/End time cols

Merge pull request #10 from moshemoshe137/bugfix/enrollments-missing-date

Add the "header above the headers"

Merge pull request #6 from moshemoshe137/feature/generate-fake-enrollments

Feature/generate fake enrollments

Fix "Start Date" error

Previously, all the dates were the same
Move all functions to the `_testing`` module

Optimize `select_categories`

The function is now vectorized to choose all students' categories at
once.

Optimize student course assignment

No more double-for-loops! This drops the running time of this cell from
~6.5 seconds to less than 1 second.

Add all other types of "Assigned Staff"

and join the results with the professors assigned earlier

Revert `Faker` dep to official release >= 23.2.0

The feature from PR joke2k/faker#1991 has been included in Faker's
official release 23.2.0 This commit points our dependency back to the
official package.

Add "Assigned Staff" based on course assignments

Next, we will have to add all the other types of staff listed in
`assigned_staff_role_probabilities`.

Fix regex typo

Oops! Last name is listed before first name,
not vice-versa!
Let 2 or 0 instructors to be assigned to a course

Fix `names_series` being unused

It also no longer calls the names `student_names`,
since we're using the function with instructors,
too.

Generate emails based on names

ChatGPT was surprisingly unhelpful with this
one...
Redo how class dates & times are simulated
Ensure consistent schedule info for each section
Ensure first and last names come from same locale

"Student Name" now appears as "{Last}, {First}"

instead of just using whatever `fake.name()`
decided to return.

Temporarily use forked `Faker` for joke2k/faker#1991

To use the `.unique` attribute on individual
locale generators, this commit points our Faker
dependency to a specific commit in my fork
(https://github.com/moshemoshe137/faker-fork/tree/40b12b5).
This change will be reverted once the feature is
merged into the official Faker release.

Implement `Flake8-pyproject`

and finally get rid of that pesky `setup.cfg`
Redo how Cumulative GPAs are created and assigned
Redo how courses are created and assigned

Define some important distributions

Data is randomly generated based on certain
distributions. If any of the dicts are unused in
the future, they can probably just be deleted

Add function `sample_from_dict`

to easily sample from a `dict` that maps keys to
weights or probabilities.

Categories and Tags functions can now return None

instead of an empty string

Ensure "Categories" and "Tags" are persistent

If a student is repeated in the enrollments
report, then their "Categories" and "Tags" need
to remain constant.

Reorder columns as in a real report

Commented out some columns that are not created yet
Allow students to appear more than once
Add generating fake enrollments reprot to GH actions

Add docstring for load_df

and docstrings for related pytest fixtures
Add methods to load EAB enrollment reports

Remove unreachable `else` statement

Seemingly unreachable, anyway
Add tests for cached pickle object
Add tests for multiple Excel sheets
Pass Excel file through all tests
Add tests for cache and pkl_name kwargs
Add basic setup for `load_df` and tests

`pre-commit autoupdate`

and update `additional_dependencies`.
Fixed one `flake8` error as well.

Upgrade GitHub actions

and fix a "Node.js 16 actions are deprecated." warning

Catch `jupyter-core` `DeprecationWarning`

This was a very weird bug, ultimately originating with
the dataframe-image package
https://chat.openai.com/share/857ab9a7-c2e3-4b15-b102-b1b5437e19bf

Silence `pandas` `DeprecationWarning`

They want me to install `pyarrow`, I guess...
So it's a dev-requirement now

Fix `pandas` `FutureWarning`

they wanted me to change the frequency aliases

Remove deprecated `pandas` function

`pandas._testing.makeDateIndex has been removed as of `pandas`
version 2.2.0

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/commit/00a0216f39b2e790a8db93c295664949862756c6

Re-enable mypy `warn_unused_ignores`

This took a long, long time to troubleshoot.
Ultimately, the issue is that `matplotlib` comes
with its own type stubs. It has to be installed for
the `type: ignore[attr-defined]` to be valid. It
must be installed in the `pre-commit` hook's
environment if we want it to pass the `nbqa` `mypy`
tests.

Fix test names for VSCode

Test names that included the current date
or time were creating race conditions in
certain circumstances. This is avoided by
just using the `strftime` code to name the
test.

Fix `_test_photos_are_equal`

The function now ignores extra file metadata and
only compares the actual images.

Partial credit to ChatGPT:
